decision: All six BMW 4x pairs improve. Small off changes, mixed BMW 2x and reported T80 costs. Retained under BMW priority.
statistics: Median of three per-pair geometric crossover ratios per audit. FPS uses pooled median candidate frame time.
guardLimit: Linux guard cannot establish Windows host idleness. Session-bookkeeping CPU records remain in original local monitors bound by SHA-256.
initialFailures: Native strict pixel-packet oracle originally linked the external cube kernel compiled with production fast-math flags, causing mismatched floats. Strict target now compiles rasterizer.c with its own strict flags; production flags and pixel tolerances are unchanged.
Initial standalone native strict-cube oracle had the same flag mismatch.
Initial canonical link used the unwritable system Emscripten cache; retry used build/emscripten-cache.
Initial standalone native object glob included stale unlinked LOD objects; fixed by selecting current 20 source names.
